objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed artifact subject to creation, editing, release, versioning, and archival in the P&R system.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Category of document such as Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, Work Instruction

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Document identifier composed of abbreviation, number, and title

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state such as In Editing, Under Review, Released, Out of Force

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Sequential version number of the document

attributes.name: valid_until_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the document's validity

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: The actual text or file content of the document

attributes.name: metadata
attributes.description: Standardized and custom properties maintained in categories

objs.name: user
objs.description: A person who interacts with documents in roles such as author, reviewer, releaser, reader, or translator.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: Function assigned to user such as Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Reader, Translator

attributes.name: group
attributes.description: User group membership for authorization and distribution

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document linked to a main document, subject to the same release cycle and versioning as its parent.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Sequential version number of the attachment

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state synchronized with main document

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: A supplementary document attached to a main document, not subject to release cycle or versioning of the parent.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Category such as brief instructions, photos, screenshots

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A suggestion for modification to an existing document, managed independently without affecting document version.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state such as Proposed, Scheduled, Completed

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A system-generated request to review and extend a document's validity period before expiration.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state such as Pending, Extended, Overridden

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request to invalidate and archive a document that no longer has validity.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state such as Proposed, Approved, Executed

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to re-validate a previously invalidated and archived document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state such as Proposed, Approved, Executed

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A maintained list of users or user groups assigned to receive notifications or acknowledgements for a document.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Category such as Email Distribution or Acknowledgement Required

attributes.name: recipients
attributes.description: User groups or persons included in the distribution

objs.name: signature
objs.description: An electronic signature applied by a workflow participant during document release or validation.

attributes.name: signer
attributes.description: The user who applied the signature

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when signature was applied

objs.name: archive
objs.description: A storage state for invalidated documents retained for a defined period before physical deletion.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Period documents are retained before physical deletion

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Author creates a new document object with selected type and optional template.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The category selected for the new document

attributes.name: template
attributes.description: Optional template selected during creation

evts.name: edit_document
evts.description: Author or co-author modifies document content or metadata properties.

attributes.name: change_type
attributes.description: Content change or metadata change

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: System automatically converts document content from source format to PDF for web display.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Administrator or document owner assigns read, write, or release permissions to users or groups.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: The role being assigned such as Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser

attributes.name: user_or_group
attributes.description: Target of authorization assignment

evts.name: submit_for_review
evts.description: Author or co-author initiates the release workflow by submitting document for reviewer approval.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Designated reviewer checks document content for technical and formal correctness.

attributes.name: decision
attributes.description: Outcome of review such as Approved or Rejected

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Designated releaser approves document and triggers automatic publication to authorized readers.

attributes.name: decision
attributes.description: Final approval or rejection of document

evts.name: sign_release
evts.description: Workflow participant electronically signs to complete their step in the release process.

attributes.name: signature
attributes.description: Electronic signature applied with timestamp

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Released document automatically becomes visible to readers in the distribution list.

evts.name: create_version
evts.description: System automatically creates new version when document content, attachments, or certain metadata are changed.

evts.name: attach_file
evts.description: Author adds a controlled attachment or supplementary file to a document.

attributes.name: attachment_type
attributes.description: Controlled document (Attachment) or non-controlled information (Additional Information)

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Employee with author rights proposes a modification to an existing document without altering current version.

evts.name: implement_change_proposal
evts.description: Author accepts a change proposal and creates new document version incorporating the change.

evts.name: request_validity_extension
evts.description: System generates a request when document validity period falls within 30 days of expiration.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Authorized user reviews document and extends validity for another defined period.

evts.name: request_override
evts.description: User creates a request to invalidate a document that no longer has validity.

evts.name: execute_override
evts.description: Authorized user invalidates document and initiates archival process.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Document is moved to archive state with access restricted to archive group only.

evts.name: request_reactivation
evts.description: Business admin creates a request to re-validate a previously archived document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Initiator confirms reactivation and system creates new version of archived document.

evts.name: distribute_document
evts.description: System delivers document notification or acknowledgement task to users in distribution list.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Email notification or acknowledgement workflow

evts.name: acknowledge_document
evts.description: Recipient confirms receipt and understanding of distributed document.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translator converts released document content into alternative language version.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: Language of translation

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Designated reviewer and releaser approve translated document version through workflow.

o2o.description: A document may have zero or more attachments; attachments are controlled and released with their parent document.
A document may have zero or more additional information items; not subject to release cycle of parent.
Change proposals are linked to and displayed within a specific document.
Documents may reference other documents as related or supporting material.
A validity extension request is created for and linked to a specific document.
An override request is created for a specific document to invalidate it.
A reactivation request targets a specific archived document for re-validation.
Each document has an assigned distribution list of users or groups who receive notifications.
Each released version of a document retains signatures from all workflow participants.
Co-authors and author-reviewer relationships create links between users on the same document.
Attachments may be supplemented with additional information.

o2e.description: A user in author role creates a new document.
A new document object is created.
A user in author or co-author role edits document content or properties.
The document is the target of editing.
A document is converted to PDF format.
A user assigns permissions to other users or groups.
Authorization is assigned to a specific document.
An author or co-author submits document for release.
Document enters the review workflow.
A designated reviewer examines and approves or rejects the document.
The document is reviewed.
A designated releaser approves the document for publication.
The document is released.
A workflow participant electronically signs to complete their role.
An electronic signature is created.
A released document is published to readers.
A new version of the document is created.
An author attaches a file or information object.
A file is attached to the document.
An attachment or additional information item is created.
An employee with author rights creates a change proposal.
A change proposal is linked to the document.
A new change proposal is created.
The document author implements a scheduled change proposal.
The document is updated with the proposed change.
The change proposal is executed.
A validity extension request is generated for the document.
A new validity extension request is created.
A releaser, author, or reviewer confirms extended validity.
The document's validity period is extended.
The request is processed and closed.
A user with write access creates an override request.
An override request is created for the document.
A new override request is created.
A releaser, or initiator with reviewer and releaser, executes the override.
The document is invalidated and marked out of force.
The override request is processed and closed.
The document is moved to archive status with access restricted.
The document enters the archive.
A business admin creates a reactivation request.
A reactivation request targets an archived document.
A new reactivation request is created.
The initiator confirms reactivation of an archived document.
An archived document is re-validated and new version created.
The reactivation request is processed and closed.
A user's membership in a distribution list triggers document notification.
The document is distributed via the distribution list.
The distribution list determines recipients of notification.
A recipient confirms acknowledgement of a distributed document.
The document acknowledgement is recorded for the document.
A translator converts released document to another language.
The document is translated to a new language version.
Designated reviewer and releaser approve the translated version.
The translated version is released and published.
